---
pagetitle: "Publications"
toc: false
listing:
  - id: articles
    contents: "articles/*.qmd"
    template: ../ejs/article.ejs
    categories: true
    sort:
      - "year desc"
      - "title"
    sort-ui: [title,author,publication,year]
    filter-ui: [title,author,publication,year]
    page-size: 10
    field-display-names: 
      publication: "Publication"
      year: "Year"
---


```{=html}
<style>
/* ===== Publication list: no bullets, no left indent ===== */
.pub-list{
  list-style: none;
  padding-left: 0;
  margin-left: 0;
}
.pub-list > li{
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
}

/* ===== Title ===== */
.pub-title-link{
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 550;
}
.pub-title-link:hover{
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}


/* ===== Meta ===== */
.pub-meta{
  margin-top: .15rem;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.72);
}

/* ===== Buttons ===== */
.paper-actions{
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.pub-btn{
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1.8px solid currentColor;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: .86rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1;
  background: transparent;
  transition: color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}
.pub-btn:hover{
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}

/* Button types */
.pub-paper{ color:#1f5fbf; }
.pub-paper:hover{ color:#174a94; background:rgba(31,95,191,.08); }

.pub-code{ color:#1f8f4d; }
.pub-code:hover{ color:#166b39; background:rgba(31,143,77,.08); }

.pub-pres{ color:#d93025; }
.pub-pres:hover{ color:#a61f18; background:rgba(217,48,37,.08); }

.pub-poster{ color:#7b4fd6; }
.pub-poster:hover{ color:#5f3fb0; background:rgba(123,79,214,.08); }

.pub-details{ color:#444; }
.pub-details:hover{ color:#111; background:rgba(0,0,0,.05); }
</style>


<style>
.pub-row{
  display:flex;
  gap:14px;
  align-items:flex-start;
}

.pub-thumb{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  width:92px;
  height:92px;
  border-radius:12px;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.10);
  box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  background:#fff;
}

.pub-thumb img{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
  display:block;
}
.pub-header{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
  margin-bottom:1rem;
}

.pub-title{
  margin:0;
  font-size:1.6rem;
  font-weight:700;
  color: var(--quarto-hl-color, #8b3f1f); /* fallback */
}

.pub-total{
  padding:6px 14px;
  border-radius:999px;
  font-size:0.9rem;
  font-weight:600;
  color: var(--quarto-hl-color, #8b3f1f);
  background: rgba(139, 63, 31, 0.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(139, 63, 31, 0.35);
  white-space:nowrap;
}



.pub-main{ flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0; }

/* ===== Placeholder thumbnail (keeps every row aligned) ===== */
.pub-thumb-empty{
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:4px;
  text-decoration:none;
  --pt:#8b3f1f;
  color:var(--pt);
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--pt) 7%, transparent);
  border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--pt) 30%, transparent);
  box-shadow:none;
}
.pub-thumb-empty i{ font-size:1.7rem; line-height:1; }
.pub-thumb-empty span{ font-size:.68rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; }
.pt-journal{ --pt:#1f5fbf; }
.pt-conference{ --pt:#b46939; }
.pt-workshop{ --pt:#1f8f4d; }

/* ===== Authors, type, status ===== */
.listing-author .author-me{ font-weight:700; color:#2e7d32; }
.pub-type{
  display:inline-block; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:1px 8px; margin-right:6px; border-radius:5px;
  color:var(--pt); border:1px solid var(--pt);
}
.pub-status{
  display:inline-block; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:700; margin-left:6px;
  padding:1px 8px; border-radius:5px;
  background:rgba(217,119,6,.15); color:#b45309;
}

/* ===== Empty state ===== */
.pub-empty{ display:none; color:rgba(0,0,0,.6); font-style:italic; margin-top:1rem; }
body.quarto-dark .pub-empty{ color:rgba(255,255,255,.6); }

/* ===== Year groups: solid line + year shown once ===== */
.pub-list > li.year-start{ border-top: 1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
.pub-list > li.year-start:first-child{ border-top-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
body.quarto-dark .pub-list > li{ border-top-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); }
body.quarto-dark .pub-list > li.year-start{ border-top-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
.pub-list > li:not(.year-start) .pub-year-side{ visibility: hidden; }

/* ===== Faded year on the right ===== */
.pub-year-side{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  align-self:flex-start;
  min-width:3.6rem;
  text-align:right;
  font-family:'PT Serif', Georgia, serif;
  font-size:1.45rem;
  font-weight:700;
  line-height:1;
  color:currentColor;
  opacity:.25;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
  user-select:none;
  transition:opacity .15s ease;
}
@media (max-width: 650px){
  .pub-year-side{ align-self:flex-end; font-size:1.3rem; }
}

/* mobile: stack nicely */
@media (max-width: 650px){
  .pub-row{ flex-direction:column; }
  .pub-thumb{ width:110px; height:110px; }
}
</style>

<nav aria-label="breadcrumb">
  <ol class="breadcrumb">
    <li class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="/">Home</a></li>
    <li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">Publications</li>
  </ol>
</nav>
```

<div class="pub-header">
  <h3 class="pub-title">Publications</h3>
  <span class="pub-total">
    <span id="pub-count-label">Total:</span> <strong id="pub-count">11</strong>
  </span>
</div>

```{=html}
<p class="pub-empty" id="pub-empty">No publications match these filters.</p>

<script>
window.addEventListener("load", function () {
  const L = (window["quarto-listings"] || {})["listing-articles"];
  const sel = document.getElementById("listing-articles-sort");
  if (!L || !sel) return;
  const all = L.items.map(i => i.elm);
  let type = "";

  /* --- Order By menu: keep the sort options, add a "Show" group for paper type --- */
  sel.removeAttribute("onchange");
  const sortGroup = document.createElement("optgroup");
  sortGroup.label = "Sort by";
  [...sel.options].filter(o => !o.disabled).forEach(o => sortGroup.appendChild(o));
  sel.appendChild(sortGroup);
  const typeGroup = document.createElement("optgroup");
  typeGroup.label = "Show";
  [["type:", "All papers (" + all.length + ")"]]
    .concat([["journal","Journal"],["conference","Conference"],["workshop","Workshop"]]
      .map(([v, t]) => ["type:" + v, t + " (" + all.filter(e => e.dataset.pubtype === v).length + ")"]))
    .forEach(([v, t]) => { const o = new Option(t, v); typeGroup.appendChild(o); });
  sel.appendChild(typeGroup);

  sel.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const o = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
    if (o.value.startsWith("type:")) {
      type = o.value.slice(5);
      if (type) L.filter(item => item.elm.dataset.pubtype === type); else L.filter();
      const n = L.matchingItems.length;
      document.getElementById("pub-count").textContent = n;
      document.getElementById("pub-count-label").textContent = type ? "Showing:" : "Total:";
      document.getElementById("pub-empty").style.display = n ? "none" : "block";
    } else {
      L.sort(o.value, { order: o.getAttribute("data-direction") });
    }
    markYears();
  });

  /* --- Show each year once, with a solid line where a new year starts --- */
  function markYears() {
    let prev = null;
    document.querySelectorAll("#listing-articles .pub-list > li").forEach(li => {
      const y = li.dataset.year || "";
      li.classList.toggle("year-start", y !== prev);
      prev = y;
    });
  }
  L.on("updated", markYears);
  markYears();
});
</script>
```
